A voice as melodious as a nightingale and a song that remains unforgettable! Enjoy “Surahidar Gardan Koyal Si Hai Awaaz” from the classic Hindi film Aman (1967), featuring Rajendra Kumar and Saira Banu. Sung by the legendary Mohammed Rafi, this beautiful melody brings back the charm and elegance of 1960s Bollywood music.
